name: app-factory
description: PRD → contract (questions upfront; a missing key → a free service for now or a "not available" note; ads + Remote Config in every app unless the PRD says no ads) → parallel build per group (logic ∥ UI ∥ flow tests) → integrator + script gate → flow tests on parallel iOS simulators, Android alongside the fixers, affected-only re-runs → parallel senior QA → one final audit that fixes, with optimisation
